findings.title: parts_qualification GAP-1 says parts_budget.json 'now includes 12.370807 W' normal converter allocation; that is the pre-AUX figure, the budget's is 13.064091 W
findings.contradicts: m3_design/assembly_review/sources/r10_design/parts_budget.json fire_current_GAP1.other_converter_load_W = 13.06409056783647 and battery_break_load_W.c_camera_radio_gps_on[1] = 13.06409056783647 (r10_parts.py other_w = loads_w['c_camera_radio_gps_on'][1]); the same paragraph's own later sentence '(other converter load 13.064 W with the 100 mA AUX allowance)'; M3_R10 'Current fire budget' 13.064091 W.
findings.evidence: parts_qualification.md line 458 (paragraph 'GAP-1, requirements audit 2 (current Calc / Inference)'): '`parts_budget.json` now includes 12.370807 W normal converter allocation with SD writes and always-on GPS/radio.' Recomputed from the budget's own inputs: buck_max 5.546269 V x (1.461 A) / 0.80 + 1.4 W + 0.825 W + R92 0.016933 W = 12.370807 W (no AUX allowance); with D-R19-14's aux_A 0.1 A: 5.546269 x 1.561 / 0.80 + 1.4 + 0.825 + 0.016933 = 13.064091 W, the value the budget holds. No key in parts_budget.json (regenerated in memory with KiCad Python from the committed board: byte-identical to the committed file, SHA-256 ecc45417...) equals 12.370807. The line dates from acba196 (round 18, before the AUX port); the paragraph was later updated for AUX elsewhere but this sentence was not. Not in rounds 24-27 triage observations.
findings.impact: The GAP-1 paragraph, labelled current, states two different 'other converter load' figures and attributes the stale one to the budget; a reader re-solving the quoted equation with 12.370807 W gets the pre-AUX currents (1.544251 ... 1.282918 A), not the bound 1.540851 ... 1.278747 A.
findings.concrete_fix: Replace '12.370807 W' with '13.064091 W (12.370807 W before D-R19-14's 100 mA AUX allowance)' in parts_qualification.md line 458.

findings.title: D-R27-01's loaded_pack uses 1.46 A + AUX, not ports_w's 1.461 A + AUX that its comment and record claim, so the 6 V four-stall figure is 4.3887 V instead of 4.3885 V on the stated basis
findings.contradicts: m3_design/r10_parts.py lines 444-446 comment: 'the ports draw camera 1 A + radio .3 + GPS .15 + 11 mA + the AUX allowance at the 5.456 V buck output, as ports_w does' (= 1.561 A); ports_w line 415 uses (1.461 + aux_A); R10_DECISIONS D-R27-01 'What': 'takes the ports' input power as 5.456 V x (1.46 A + aux_A), the way ports_w does'.
findings.evidence: r10_parts.py line 448: power = 5.456 * (1.46 + aux_A), i.e. 1.56 A (1 + 0.3 + 0.15 + 0.010), while ports_w (line 415) and the battery-break / fire loads use 1.461 + aux_A = 1.561 A (the 11 mA quiescent the comment names). Re-solving the generator's own equation (pack 0.15 ohm, logic 0.6375 A, 7.68 A stalls, 80 %): with 1.56 A, 5.881014 / 4.388745 V (the budget's pack_7V4 / pack_6V0_four_stall_loaded_V); with the stated 1.561 A, 5.880831 / 4.388491 V. The 6 V figure quoted to 3 decimals in STATUS, parts_qualification (lines 665-666) and D-R27-01 (4.389 V) becomes 4.388 V on the stated basis; the 7.4 V figure stays 5.881 V.
findings.impact: Immaterial to any limit (0.25 mV), but D-R27-01's fix does not do what its comment and record say: the four-stall pack sag still omits the 11 mA port quiescent allowance that every other port figure in the budget carries.
findings.concrete_fix: In loaded_pack use 5.456 * (1.461 + aux_A) (or reword the comment and D-R27-01 to say 1.46 A, 10 mA quiescent); regenerate parts_budget.json and update the 4.389 V / 4.388745 V quotations (STATUS, parts_qualification, D-R27-01) if the code changes.

findings.title: parts_qualification says the current board has four C21397 22 uF capacitors on PORT_4V8 (C406, C407, C411, C421); it has five (C445 too) and three 100 nF (C444 too)
findings.contradicts: Fab BOM m3_bom_jlc.csv line for C21397: 'C82,C400,C401,C403,C404,C405,C406,C407,C411,C421,C431,C445,C461'; netlist schematic.net.xml net PORT_4V8: C406.1 C407.1 C410.1 C411.1 C420.1 C421.1 C444.1 C445.1 ...; parts_qualification's own round 19 table row 'J440, R470 / R471, D440 / D441, C444, C445 ... 22 uF C21397'.
findings.evidence: parts_qualification.md lines 584-586 ('Supply contract and sources'): 'Capacitors reuse Murata GRM32ER71E226KE15L C21397 ... on the current board: two at the buck input (C400, C401), three on PORT_5V3 ... (C403, C404, C405), four on PORT_4V8 (C406, C407, C411, C421, plus C410 and C420 as local bypasses) and one on CAM_5V (C431).' The netlist puts C445 (22 uF 25V X7R, C21397) and C444 (100 nF) on PORT_4V8 (D-R19-14's AUX cell; both are in hotplug_inputs.json). The other counts in the sentence are right (C430 on PORT_5V3 is 100 nF). The line dates from acba196 (round 18, before the AUX cell); the file header says round 19 amendments supersede earlier text where they differ, but this sentence states the count 'on the current board'.
findings.impact: Wrong inventory for U401's output capacitance (five 22 uF, 110 uF nominal, not four), the figure a stability or retained-output check would start from.
findings.concrete_fix: Change to 'five on PORT_4V8 (C406, C407, C411, C421, C445, plus C410, C420 and C444 as local bypasses)'.

observations: parts_qualification 'Battery-lead break ride-through' table and OQ-5 paragraph (lines 779-813) cite parts_budget.json but carry a pre-microSD, pre-AUX model: (a) 8.7 / 8.2 ms, (c) 0.55-0.65 / 0.53-0.62 ms, OQ-5 4.6 / 7.2 and 2.3 / 3.7 ms, versus the budget's 7.43-7.49 / 7.05-7.11, 0.49-0.57 / 0.46-0.54, 3.84 / 6.00 and 1.57 / 2.46 ms (reproduced exactly by removing the SD terms and aux_A). The file header states the always-on/microSD amendment 'supersedes the earlier ... ride-through records', so by the R25 obs-9 precedent not counted; labelling the section historical or regenerating it would remove the ambiguity.

Q122 gate against a 30 kOhm PC1 pull-up: docs (M3_R10 Power, R10_VALIDATION 2550/2674, REQUIREMENTS F8, M3_R10 1141) say 'at most 0.218 V (3.6 V x 2 / 33)', the nominal-resistor figure; with 1 % parts the budget's Q122_gate_with_30k_pullup_PC1_unconfigured_V is 0.2203 V. Seen by round 26 MCU as nominal vs 1 %; 0.43 V below the 0.65 V threshold either way.

ORDERING 8.1.1 pad-energy worksheet (sealed D-R17-01) uses 0.461 A for GPS, radio and quiescent and no AUX allowance; with a 100 mA AUX device the board input rises by about 0.69 W. The worksheet states its inputs and its larger conservative margins (1.4 W logic, continuous SD) exceed this; owner row 17 is open.

U400 input feed (RAW_PROTECTED F.Cu 0.4 mm, C400/C401 to U400.2/.3) is not a K-power path; at the normal 1.561 A port load it needs 0.32 mm at 30 C even at the 5.71 V four-stall BAT_IN; only the camera-short fault (firmware-cleared, 11 ms deglitch) at 5.71 V needs 0.43 mm. Not continuous; as round 25 obs 8.

K-power's U9 IN / OUT 2.9 A design current (D-R3-03) covers every continuous budget case: 13.064 W at 5.71 V is 2.29 A, the camera-short case 14.79 W at 5.71 V 2.59 A; the 3.744 A port-fault peak is buck-limited hiccup.

M3_R10 / ORDERING / R10_VALIDATION row 26: 'U400 and L400 lose 1.2-2.2 W' (Inference). The budget's 80-85 % efficiency at the 1.561 A allocation gives 1.48-2.16 W; 1.2 W needs about 87.5 % (round 20 power used 80-88 %). Upper bound, which drives the conclusion, agrees.
parts_qualification 'Inference, upstream coordination' (2.92 A asserted, 3.6 A) remains port-switch-era text; already R25-POWER obs 9.

Every K-power path passes on a0ec075e (power_paths run read-only): IPC-2152 floors 0.68 mm (2.9 A), 0.326 mm (1.9 A), 0.299 mm (1.81 A), 0.356 mm (2.0 A), 0.167 mm (1.294 A), 0.157 mm (1.249 A) against drawn floors 1.0 / 0.7 / 0.4 mm; only the six named POWER_NARROW entries are narrower.

Regulator taps: U400's R400.1 taps C403.1 (a stub capacitor off the L400.2 1.0 mm run) through 0.2 mm F.Cu; U401's R402.1 sits on U401's B.Cu OUT run before the In2 vias; U2.1 (AP63203 FB) reaches In2 3V3 through two vias (23.2, 68.6) and (23.0, 70.0). Each is in SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS.
TPS7A91 recommended COUT minimum 10 uF and VIN 1.4-6.5 V hold: PORT_5V3 max 5.546 V, five 22 uF on PORT_4V8; IGND 4 mA used in GAP-3 is the SBVS282A p5 maximum at 1 A (3.5 mA at VIN 6.5 V, 5 mA).
U9 VOVLO recommended range 0.5-1.5 V (SLVSFC9C p8) holds for BAT_IN about 4.07-12.2 V with R82 2 M / R83 280 k; records already disclose the 12.2 V upper edge.

R80 + R165 = 940 kOhm and R82 = 2 MOhm meet TI's '350 kOhm or higher' recommendation for EN / OVLO pull-ups exposed to reverse polarity (SLVSFC9C p7 note 2); R84 750 ohm is inside RILM 549-6650 ohm (p8).
